canonical_account_fields.account_version: monotone transaction version; optimistic concurrency is not UI-only
canonical_account_fields.permanent_shards: nonnegative integer; actual D01/D08 accepted awards minus purchases plus valid refunds
canonical_account_fields.talent_ranks: map TalentID to integer owned rank; no allocation slots
canonical_account_fields.talent_purchase_receipts: PurchaseOperationID -> TalentID, rank, actual_paid_shards, price_rules_version, refunded_by_reset_operation_id or null
canonical_account_fields.research_purchase_receipts: ResearchOperationID -> ContentUnlockID, actual_paid_shards and price_rules_version; never refunded in D09
canonical_account_fields.permanent_sample_purchased: ContentUnlockID -> boolean; separate from research; never reset with talents or run death
canonical_account_fields.selected_sample_unlock_id: pending next-run selection: null or one researched and not-yet-purchased ContentUnlockID; transferred to run snapshot and cleared atomically at new-run creation
canonical_account_fields.active_run_id: null only after no unfinished active/suspended/starting/ending/recovery run remains
canonical_account_fields.operation_journal: OperationID -> exact request digest and committed result; retries return same result, changed payload with same ID rejects
canonical_account_fields.earned_shards_total: actual accepted D08 awards only; refunds are not new earned currency

derived_fields.unlocked_item_ids: 22 D03 base IDs plus item_id from unlocked_research_ids via unlocks.json; not an independently editable account flag
derived_fields.talent_contributions: sum owned_rank * per_rank_contributions once; cumulative reference rows are not additional sources

lifecycle.abandon: explicit D01 abandon ends run; keep already banked shards, no new Boss/clear/exit reward; suspended abandon uses same ending transaction
lifecycle.starting_or_ending_failure: enter RECOVERY_REQUIRED; reconcile same operation/RunID before allowing any account edit or second run
lifecycle.active_rewards: D08 permanent award transactions may credit shards during RUN_ACTIVE; this does not permit hub purchases
lifecycle.concurrency: one unfinished run per account, not just one per UI; new-run claim and profile purchases serialize on account_version

hub_transaction.commit: currency, owned ranks/research, actual-paid receipt where applicable, account_version and journal as one logical transaction
hub_transaction.duplicate_matching_operation: return original committed result without second mutation even if current version advanced
hub_transaction.duplicate_different_payload: reject; cannot reuse OperationID as a new purchase
hub_transaction.lost_response_after_commit: read committed journal result; no retry deduction
hub_transaction.purchase_talent: owned rank -> owned rank+1 only, max_rank and same-profile rank prerequisites; new receipt even if earlier ranks were refunded
hub_transaction.purchase_research: one permanent flag, each prerequisite permanent research required; no talent/prior loot/Boss gate; no duplicate fee
hub_transaction.select_sample: no cost; null clears; nonnull requires researched and permanent_sample_purchased false; frozen again at new-run commit
hub_transaction.stale_preview: reject without charge and show new preview; never silently apply changed price or rank

talent_reset.refund_formula: sum(actual_paid_shards for exactly currently-owned rank receipts with refunded_by_reset_operation_id null)
talent_reset.requires_receipt_coverage: each current rank 1..owned_rank has exactly one active receipt; no orphan active receipt, duplicate rank or negative paid amount
atomic_effects: mark each refunded receipt with reset OperationID
talent_reset.zero_rank_reset: valid no-op with zero refund; duplicate same OperationID returns same result
talent_reset.receipt_missing_or_inconsistent: no partial reset/refund; preserve state, flag RECOVERY_REQUIRED for D13 migration; never infer old payments from current schedule
talent_reset.price_migration: refund original paid amount only, not current rank price or max catalog280; migration beyond this invariant deferred to D13
talent_reset.conservation_invariant_without_admin_mig: earned_shards_total = permanent_shards + sum(unrefunded actual talent payments) + sum(actual permanent research payments)

new_run.single_atomic_start: claim new unique RunID and account version; freeze progression data and initialize starter exactly once; failure recovery uses same operation
new_run.pending_sample_commit: nonnull account selection must still be live researched and permanent_sample_purchased false; freeze into run then clear account selected_sample_unlock_id to null in same start transaction; stale invalid selection rejects without charge/run creation and shows correction
new_run.start_retry: matching OperationID restores same created RunID and snapshot; never consumes a new pending selection or overwrites snapshot with cleared null
new_run.next_run_without_reselection: no sample selected or extra offer, whether prior selected sample was bought or not; unbought qualification can be explicitly selected again
new_run.sample_purchase_flags_snapshot: copy permanent_sample_purchased at start; later sample purchase additionally validates live flag

starter.health: full legal max HP derived from frozen talents and deterministic starter

new_run.new_instances_and_cooldowns: fresh only for new RunID; deterministic starter ownership, no sample item automatically granted
new_run.cross_chapter: D01 successful transition recovery only; never new-run initializer
new_run.unsupported_version: preserve save and require explicit migration/recovery; do not load latest talent values into old attack/room state

sample_cross_scope_transaction.source: unlocks.json research_sample_order defines eligibility, exact prices and first qualifying merchant binding
commit_together: one unique item instance delivery and any legal replacement
sample_cross_scope_transaction.insufficient_money_or_capacity_or_lost_m: reject, no deduction/no flag/no replacement; keep same offer binding
sample_cross_scope_transaction.cancelled_or_interrupted_precommit: no transaction effects; real elapsed time and damage never rolled back
sample_cross_scope_transaction.after_commit_death_or_discard: sample flag remains true; no cross-run item refund
sample_cross_scope_transaction.unbought_at_run_end: item not granted, account flag false, selection may be made again next new run
sample_cross_scope_transaction.duplicate_commit: same journal record and same instance, not a second delivery
sample_cross_scope_transaction.incomplete_save_recovery: block new run/account mutation until same operation is reconciled across account and run; D13 implementation required

v2 original intrinsic negative-affix eligibility does not expand with TAL-GRD or forge
